On Wed, Oct 7, 2026 at 10:02 AM markus_klein@redwood.ai wrote:
> Hi Oliver — thanks for the heads up and the timing. I'm looping in Laura (legal) and Jonas (product infra) to pull the inventory and confirm any residency/KMS details.

Hi all — attaching the inventory export (redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20261007.csv). Summary for Bluecrest:

- Current roster includes (high level): EdgeCache Ltd., TelemetryStream Inc., KeySafe/KMS (managed), EdgeBeam Relay (provisional), CloudStorage EU (onshore), Observify (metrics). See CSV for full columns (role, location, data path).
- EdgeBeam status: PROVISIONAL onboarding scheduled to go live 2026-10-15 for limited telemetry relay in EU region only. Their scope is request-level telemetry (latency, status codes) and aggregated sampling; they will not receive request bodies or token content.
- KMS / keys: EdgeBeam will not have KMS access. All encryption/decryption for customer data occurs in our managed KMS (KeySafe) or the customer's own KMS when configured. We will never provision private customer keys to EdgeBeam.
- Residency: For EU customers, EdgeBeam will operate from an Ireland data center (eu-west-1). We have an export-control and dataflow annex in place — see attached edgebeam_sla_ku_jurisdiction.pdf and onboarding summary.

Attachments: redwood_subprocessor_inventory_20261007.csv, edgebeam_onboarding_summary_v1.pdf, edgebeam_sla_ku_jurisdiction.pdf

If Bluecrest needs logs/evidence for the audit (e.g., SHA-signed roster snapshot or an on-demand export of the subprocessor manifest), we can provide a signed CSV and a short attestation.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
